name: Sudova
tagline: Industrial cleaning that doesn't leave a mess in your spreadsheet.
positioning: Sudova coordinates crews, chemicals, and compliance for plants and warehouses — so facilities teams stop babysitting clipboards and start trusting the floor.

hero.h1: The grime is inevitable. The paperwork isn't.
hero.sub: Sudova runs the unglamorous side of industrial cleaning — crew dispatch, chemical logs, and audit-ready proof — across every site you're responsible for.

features.title: Dispatch that reads the floor
features.description: Assign crews by shift, zone, and hazard level. Sudova reshuffles jobs the second a line goes down, so nobody scrubs a tank that's still running.

features.title: Chemical logs that don't lie
features.description: Every dilution, batch, and MSDS lookup is timestamped at the point of use. When an auditor asks, you export the record instead of inventing it.

features.title: Proof of clean, on demand
features.description: Crews snap before-and-after photos tied to each work order. Managers approve from their phone and the sign-off sticks to the job forever.

features.title: One dashboard, every site
features.description: Roll up 3 plants or 300. Filter by facility, contractor, or SLA breach without stitching together twelve different spreadsheets.

features.title: Alerts before the fine
features.description: Set thresholds for missed rounds, expired certs, and overdue deep cleans. Sudova pings the right person while it's still cheap to fix.

features.title: Usage that adds up
features.description: Track labor hours, chemical draw, and equipment runtime per square foot. Bill clients or charge back departments with numbers you can defend.

testimonials.quote: We used to reconstruct sanitation logs the night before every audit. Now the record already exists. Our last USDA visit took forty minutes instead of two days.
testimonials.name: Marisol Reyes

testimonials.quote: Sudova caught that a contractor skipped 14 deep-clean cycles across three warehouses. That's the kind of thing you find out during a recall, not a Tuesday. We found out on a Tuesday.
testimonials.name: Devon Achterberg

testimonials.quote: Our chemical spend dropped 19% once we could see who was over-diluting and who was flooding the floor. Turns out 'a little extra' costs six figures.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar
